emails.subject: Submission accepted - you ranked
emails.body:
Hi —

Accepted. The facilitator has reviewed the PR, the suite, and the production story. Your submission is on the board.

  Points: 88.0
  Rank in KOL-001: #1 of 1
  Visible checks: 9 passed
  Your spend: $518.00

Now that the workshop considers you 'done', here is the full handoff:

  1. Usage metrics: your Kimchi key spend lives in
     https://app.kimchi.dev/usage . Download the CSV from that page —
     the CSV is what the leaderboard uses to attribute your cost.
     If you haven't uploaded it yet, drop it as an attachment on your PR.

  2. Post-acceptance scan: the production workflow re-runs nightly
     against your branch. If a regression slips in before Monday,
     it will fire the same incident engine we used here — useful
     context, no action needed from you unless that email pings you.

  3. Next steps: hand the repo to the next engineer on your team.
     They start at the same briefing inbox you did.

The PR stays open in the queue for audit, but the leaderboard row is permanent. If you want to see the production story that got you here, check your inbox — Alex sent it already.

Now go help the next person. The company is in good hands.

— Sam
